of the Tariff
and Customs Code of 1978
(Presidential Decree No. 1464), as amended, empowers the President of the
Republic of the Philippines to increase, reduce, or remove existing rates of import
duty, as well as to modify the form of duty and the tariff nomenclature under
Section 104 of said Code;
NOW, THEREFORE, I, GLORIA MACAPAGAL-ARROYO,
President of
the Republic of the Philippines, by virtue of the powers vested in me by law, do
hereby order:
.
1.
The articles specifically listed in Annex "A" hereof, as
classified under Section 104 of the Tariff and Customs Code of 1978, as
amended, shall be subject to the Most-favoured-Nation
(MfN) rate of import
duty in accordance with the schedule indicated opposite each article.
2.
The nomenclature and rates of import duty on tariff
headings not enumerated and those listed but represented by the symbol "x x x"
shall remain in force and in effect.
Upon the effectivity of this Executive Order, the articles
specifically
in Annex "A" which
are entered
and withdrawn
warehouses in the Philippines for consumption shall be levied the MFN rates of
duty therein prescribed.

All presidential
issuances, administrative
regulations,
or parts thereof, which are contrary to or inconsistent with this
Executive Order are hereby revoked or modified accordingly.
This Executive Order shall take effect thirty
following its complete publication in two (2) newspapers of general circulation in
the Philippines.
Done in the City of Manila, this
of Our Lord Two Thousand and Five.
